texts: swan, love within
After years of chasing pilgrimages across the country, my warmest prayer happened sitting quietly at dawn, watching a white swan glide over the pond outside.
hey can you do a doha where a swan shows that loving God is an inner thing, not a trip somewhere
O white swan gliding on silent waters, teach my heart to love the Lord who lives inside its own still depths.
I want a doha about a swan that needs no journey to reach the Beloved because it carries its love inside; let it say that real devotion is quiet and private, never a public performance.
On the cremation ground I watched a widow whisper to God with no ritual at all, and her love looked purer than any grand ceremony I have attended. Please write a doha about that quiet inner devotion.
My uncle never went on pilgrimages, but standing at the cremation ground after his funeral I understood he had loved God silently every single day of his life.
Where the last embers glow on the cremation ground, the true lover needs no chanting, only a heart that burns for the One within.
yo, doha about loving God inside you, set at a cremation ground? thinking of my dad
cremation ground, inner love
I sold cotton in the market all my life and never had time for fancy worship, yet each evening I feel God sitting right inside my chest.
Amid bales of cotton and the clamour of the market, the true lover hears only the Beloved humming softly inside his heart.
Write me a doha about a cotton seller in a busy market whose love for God needs no outer display; the Lord lives in his heart while his hands stay busy with trade, and he knows it.
can u make a doha - cotton, market, and loving God within
cotton market, devotion within
diamond, blind man, love inside
friend, people roam like a blind man outside when the diamond of devotion is in their chest, can you make a doha about that
My cousin runs from one holy place to another like a blind man, forgetting that the diamond of devotion lies buried in his heart. Please give me a doha that tells him to look inward instead.
Like a blind man hunting a diamond he already holds in his fist, the seeker roams the world for a Lord who sleeps in his own love.
A diamond dealer I know sees every gem in the world but walks like a blind man past the love for God sitting quietly in his own heart.
I would like a doha for a friend who thinks a cleric must stand between him and God; tell him gently that true love for the Lord already lives within his own chest and needs no go-between.
cleric, love within
doha pls: cleric shouting about God while the real love sits quietly inside us
The cleric weaves his sermons high, yet the Beloved listens to the whisper that rises unseen from a loving heart.
The cleric near our lane lectures for hours about rules, but my quiet neighbour who never preaches feels closer to God than anyone I know.
Every weekend my family drives hours to some famous holy place, but my grandmother just sits by her window at dusk, smiling as if someone were keeping her company.
Why wander, O pilgrim, to far-off places? The Beloved sleeps in the hush behind your ribs, awaiting only love to wake Him.
love of God inside
Please write a doha about a seeker who travels to every famous holy place yet feels empty, then discovers that his love for God was always waiting quietly inside him, needing no travel at all.
hey, need a doha about loving God quietly in your own heart instead of running around looking for Him
sun, milk, devotion within
Give me a doha that uses the rising sun and a bowl of milk to show that the love of God is not offered in some distant place, but is poured out silently from the heart each day.
can you write a doha with sun and milk about loving God from the inside
Each morning my mother pours fresh milk for the household while the sun rises, and she hums a name softly as if the Lord were standing beside her.
As the sun pours warmth on morning milk, so love pours quietly from the lover's heart to the Lord who lives there.
I was terrified crossing the choppy bay in a small boat, then I felt a calm warmth in my chest and realized I was never alone, and a lion roared in the zoo behind us.
Could you write a doha where a fearless lion and a small boat tossed on the waves show that the man who loves God from within stays unafraid, because the Lord is not outside but in his heart?
boat, lion, inner devotion
Though the lion roars upon the shore and the boat rocks in the dark, the lover rests, for God is sailing inside his heart.
doha with a boat and a lion about true love of God being inside you not out there somewhere
My aunt fasted, travelled and performed every rite, yet she always seemed restless, while the old woman in the next lane just talked to God over her tea and seemed full of peace.
Love the Lord as the earth loves rain, quietly drinking, never shouting; He is nearer than your own pulse.
I'm struggling because everyone around me prays loudly and travels to distant holy places, but I feel closest to God in silence. Write a doha affirming that love of God belongs inside the heart.
inner love, not outer show
something on loving God for real, in the heart, not for display
Please write a doha in which a tongue trips over fine words yet a humble man beneath a date palm loves God sincerely from the heart; show that inward love matters, while outward speech means little.

date palm, tongue, heartfelt love
need a doha - date palm, tongue, and God lives in the heart not in words
Tall as the date palm stands the lover's longing, and no tongue is needed when the heart itself becomes the song.
Skeleton and shadow will both crumble, yet the love that burns within the heart belongs to the Beloved forever.

skeleton, shadow, God within
doha about a skeleton and a shadow and how real devotion lives inside, not outside
I stood in the anatomy room staring at a skeleton and my own shadow on the wall, and wondered what part of me actually loves God, and it felt like something deeper than bones.
My neighbour asked why I never visit holy places anymore; I told him I found what I was after in my own heart, and it felt like a cage springing open.
doha on loving God inside your own heart, with a cage in it somewhere
The cage of the world cannot hold the lover's heart, for the Beloved lives within and the bars melt in His light.
Please give me a doha with a cage in it, where the bird of the soul needs no far journey to find the Lord, because true love of God sings right inside the heart.
cage, love within
doha on loving God inside the heart, with a stone in it please
My brother kneels before a carved stone every morning and says that is love, but when I sit in silence and feel warmth in my chest, I believe I am closer to God.

Hard is the stone and mute, but the heart that loves can speak, and the Lord answers from within it.
stone god, living love
thief, fish, God within
The thief prowls the shore and the fish hides in deep water; so hides the Beloved in the deep of the loving heart.

Compose a doha with a thief and a fish: the thief steals everything outside but cannot touch what the fish-like soul swims in, the love of God deep within the heart.
doha about a thief and a fish, and real love of God being inside where nobody can steal it
cloth sheet, quiet devotion
On a worn cloth sheet the lover lies down, and in the quiet dark the Lord arises from within his own sighs.
At night I spread my old cloth sheet on the floor and pray without words; no ceremony, only warmth in my chest, and I think that is enough.
Please write a doha about a poor devotee praying on nothing but a simple cloth sheet, who needs no costly offerings because his love for God springs from the heart and nowhere else.
can you do a doha with a cloth sheet, the kind of love for God that's inside, not for show
Give me a doha about the musk deer who wanders in search of a scent it carries within, like a pilgrim who looks everywhere for a Lord already dwelling in his loving heart.
musk deer, love within
doha plz, musk deer and loving God inside, you know that classic vibe
I was mocked for staying away from famous holy places, but like a musk deer that finally sniffs its own scent, I found my peace sitting with the love inside me.

moneylender and swan, doha on loving God in the heart please
moneylender, swan, inner love

doha: grindstone, simple work, and loving God from the heart not through ritual
grindstone, love inside

loving God within

short doha about true love for God living inside, not in rituals

Not in far-off lands, not in sacred noise, the Beloved is born each morning in the quiet room of the heart.
cage, market, heartfelt love
Please compose a doha in which the busy market bargains for holiness while the heart, like a bird in a cage, finds that God can only be loved inside, never bought or found in outer trade.

doha with cage and market about loving God within please

palanquin, inner love

I want a doha about a palanquin and how real love of God isn't in pomp but inside

Last night I sat on the balcony under the moon with no prayer to recite, and my heart simply filled with a love so large it felt like God was in my breath.
doha about the moon and loving God inside, not somewhere out there

moon, devotion inside

doha pls: swan, winnowing fan, and loving God inside the heart
swan, winnowing fan, love within

devotion, not display

can u do a doha about how real love for God is inside you and doesn't need a big event

washerman and God inside the heart, doha please
washerman, love within

river, inner devotion

tongue, bee, love inside

can you write a doha with a bee and tongue about loving God from within

need a doha, loving God inside, nothing fancy
devotion, quiet and inward

house, milk, heartfelt devotion
a doha with house and milk, and loving God inside your heart

doha with fish and mountain about loving God from within pls

fish, mountain, inner love
palace, inner devotion

bhakti doha - love for the Lord in your own heart, fresh imagery please

loving the Lord within

doha with a forest and a diamond: stop looking for God out there, love Him in the heart

doha with a blind man loving God inside his heart pls

bridge, love within

tongue, moneylender, love inside
cleric, heartfelt love
doha about a cleric lecturing on God while love for Him really lives in your heart

short doha about loving God inside you and not looking outside

devotion within, not outside

palanquin doha: real love for God is within, not in the show around it

bhakti doha please, love for God inside the heart, not displayed

doha pls, a water well and loving God in the heart, not at some far place

can u make a doha of a potter and clay and true bhakti being inside the heart
doha on bhakti, how love for the divine is already inside us
love of God inside

swan, sandalwood, love inside
